The '''All Terrain Exploration and Survey Walker (AT-EST)''' was a [[Walker/Legends|walker]] design used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[civilian exploratory corps]] and later other groups.<ref name="EotE:CR" />

==Characteristics==
The AT-EST was designed by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]] for the civilian exploratory corps as a six-legged, low-slung walker design. It could carry 8 passengers as well as cargo. The AT-EST could traverse various hostile terrain.<ref name="EotE:CR" />

The walker had one [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] at the front of the vehicle and was crewed by three people, a pilot, a co-pilot and a sensor/comms operator.<ref name="EotE:CR" />

A smaller variant of the AT-EST was the [[All Terrain Exploration Transport/Legends|All Terrain Exploration Transport]].<ref name="SS">''[[Savage Spirits]]''</ref>
